title: Node Differential Privacy via Node-Stable Graph Projections
abstract: arXiv:2611.33672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Node-differentially private algorithms enable learning on network-structured datasets in which records reflect interactions among individuals. They protect the privacy of each individual's information, including all their associated records. A key challenge in the design of such algorithms is to exploit the structure of realistic graphs---where most nodes have low degree---to achieve high accuracy, without compromising on the worst-case privacy guarantee.   In this work we give two new tools for designing accurate, computationally efficient node-differentially private algorithms. First, we give a nearly linear time, randomized, node-stable graph projection: the projection leaves graphs of maximum degree $D$ unchanged, maps arbitrary graphs to subgraphs of maximum degree $\hat D \approx D$, and ensures that changing one node of the input graph has only a small effect on the distribution of the edges selected among the remaining vertices

translated_title: 基于节点稳定图投影的节点差分隐私
translated_abstract: 节点差分隐私算法能够在网络结构化数据集上进行学习，其中记录反映了个体之间的交互。这类算法保护每个个体信息的隐私，包括其所有相关记录。设计此类算法的一个关键挑战在于：如何利用现实图的结构特性（即大多数节点具有较低的度数）来实现高精度，同时不损害最坏情况下的隐私保证。在这项工作中，我们为设计精确且计算高效的节点差分隐私算法提供了两个新工具。首先，我们给出了一种近线性时间的随机化节点稳定图投影：该投影使最大度数为 $D$ 的图保持不变，将任意图映射为最大度数 $\hat D \approx D$ 的子图，并确保改变输入图中的一个节点只会对在其余顶点中所选边的分布产生很小的影响。
tldr: 本文提出了一种近线性时间的节点稳定图投影方法，该方法可将任意图映射为有界度数的子图且对单节点变化保持稳定，从而为设计精确高效的节点差分隐私算法提供了新的核心工具。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a nearly linear-time, randomized node-stable graph projection that maps arbitrary graphs to bounded-degree subgraphs while ensuring stability under single-node changes, enabling the design of accurate and computationally efficient node-differentially private algorithms.
